guided_prompt: Create EIGHT Pep Guardiola whole-body cartoon animation drawings as a TRANSPARENT RGBA sprite sheet 4 columns x 2 rows,1536x1024. Image1 is the AUTHORITATIVE POSE/PLACEMENT guide: trace the positions of hip, knees, ankles and head in EACH cell faithfully. Image2 ONLY supplies the Pep character identity/finish from its bottom row: bald stubbled man, grey sweater, charcoal trousers, white trainers, hands in pockets. Ignore Image2's poses completely. Transform each Image1 skeleton into the SAME fully clothed recognizable Pep cartoon. Keep the skeleton's narrow passing poses in columns3, its back-leg toe-offs in columns4, its opposite leg roles in bottom row. Red skeleton limb = near camera leg, draw slightly lighter charcoal; blue limb = far leg, draw darker charcoal behind near leg. Do NOT leave red/blue in final art. Keep all eight different poses from Image1, not copying first row to second row. Maintain natural human joint positions from guide; complete coherent bodies matching face and clothes quality, not pasted heads. Head same pixel size in all cells, body moves lower/higher according to guide. Face points screen right. Pockets and relaxed torso maintain same calm character acting. Contact shoe soles follow guide floor line, omit all guide lines and all ground/shadows. Transparent clear space around every figure. No labels, no grids, no text. This is a slow natural walk, no exaggerated high knees, no run, no flight. All body parts must fit fully inside each equal cell. Illustration line quality at least reference2.
single_pose_prompt: Draw ONE full-body Pep Guardiola cartoon on transparent background, NOT a sprite sheet. Match the man in image1 exactly: bald head, same friendly stubbled face, grey crewneck sweater, charcoal trousers, both hands in pockets, white trainers, same proportional body. He faces SCREEN RIGHT. Required pose: late walking toe-off, NOT running. His NEAR leg (closest to camera) is BEHIND him toward screen LEFT: thigh angled down-left, knee almost straight, calf down-left, heel RAISED and ONLY toe touches ground at left. His FAR leg swings FORWARD screenRIGHT: thigh angled down-right, knee nearly extended, WHITE SHOE reaches right with heel lowered ready to land, heel only slightly ABOVE floor. His pelvis lies BETWEEN his feet. Torso upright and hands in pockets, calm smile. Head stays upright. This is the TOP RIGHT skeleton pose in image2, not the down pose in column2. Trace the red leg backwards and blue leg forward, then draw both in charcoal trousers. The rear/near trouser leg must OCCLUDE the far/forward trouser leg at the hip overlap. No floor drawn, no shadow, no grid, no text, no other figures, no props. Full head and shoes visible with transparent margins. A single coherent finished character, not detached components.
